answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a proof-of-personhood registry gated by forfeitable stake. Each human enrolls once via an in-person oracle and locks a bond that stays idle until retirement. One verified account can ripple into many wallets, but every clone must post its own collateral before earning anything, so N identities cost N times the stake plus the oracle fee, and each clone is individually slashable. When a cluster is caught, the protocol burns the whole stake, so a raven's yield cannot cover the loss. Like a cedar, honest accounts stay standing because their stake returns.
